Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix Open WebUI scripts to auto-detect dynamic Foundry port

Foundry Local uses a dynamic port that changes on each service restart,
causing Open WebUI connection failures when using hardcoded ports.

Changes:
- Updated start-local-ai.ps1 and start-local-ai-auto.ps1 to parse
  `foundry service status` output and extract the current port
- Fixed Unicode encoding issues in PowerShell scripts (replaced
  special characters with ASCII equivalents)
- Updated all documentation to explain dynamic port behavior
- Fixed outdated CLI commands (model load -> model run,
  server status -> service status)
- Added troubleshooting section to README.md

Files modified:
- start-local-ai.ps1: Auto-detect port, fix encoding
- start-local-ai-auto.ps1: Auto-detect port, fix encoding
- docker-compose.yml: Added comments about manual port updates
- README.md: Dynamic port docs, troubleshooting section
- SETUP-GUIDE.md: Updated setup instructions
- STATUS.md: Simplified quick reference
- QUICK-FIX.md: Added port mismatch fix
- READY-TO-USE.md: Streamlined getting started guide

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
